package csuite

import (
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// CsuiteAgent tracks a monitored agent in the C-Suite dashboard.
type CsuiteAgent struct {
	ID              uuid.UUID      `gorm:"type:text;primaryKey"`
	Name            string         `gorm:"uniqueIndex;not null"`
	Status          AgentMonStatus `gorm:"not null;default:offline"`
	HeartbeatAt     *time.Time
	ContextPercent  int    `gorm:"default:0"`
	CurrentActivity string `gorm:"default:''"`
	CreatedAt       time.Time
	UpdatedAt       time.Time
}

// CsuiteInboxMessage tracks messages between agents in the C-Suite dashboard.
type CsuiteInboxMessage struct {
	ID        uuid.UUID `gorm:"type:text;primaryKey"`
	FromAgent string    `gorm:"not null"`
	ToAgent   string    `gorm:"not null"`
	Subject   string    `gorm:"not null"`
	Body      string
	Priority  InboxPriority    `gorm:"not null;default:normal"`
	Type      InboxMessageType `gorm:"not null;default:status"`
	Archived  bool             `gorm:"default:false"`
	CreatedAt time.Time
	UpdatedAt time.Time
}

}

import (
	"bytes"
	"testing"

	"github.com/godinj/drem-orchestrator/internal/csuite"
	"github.com/godinj/drem-orchestrator/internal/testutil"
	"github.com/jinzhu/gorm"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestSendCommand_CreatesMessage(t *testing.T) {
	db := testutil.NewTestDBWithModels(t)
	defer db.Close()

	args := []string{
		"send",
		"--from", "kyle",
		"--to", "alex",
		"--subject", "Test",
		"--priority", "high",
		"--type", "request",
		"--body", "Hello",
	}

	err := run(args, db, nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	var msg csuite.CsuiteInboxMessage
	err = db.Where("from_agent = ? AND to_agent = ?", "kyle", "alex").First(&msg).Error
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, "Test", msg.Subject)
	assert.Equal(t, string(csuite.InboxPriorityHigh), string(msg.Priority))
	assert.Equal(t, string(csuite.InboxMessageTypeRequest), string(msg.Type))
	assert.Equal(t, "Hello", msg.Body)
}

func TestSendCommand_MissingRequiredFlags(t *testing.T) {
	db := testutil.NewTestDBWithModels(t)
	defer db.Close()

	// Missing --from
	args := []string{
		"send",
		"--to", "alex",
		"--subject", "Test",
	}

	err := run(args, db, nil)
	require.Error(t, err)
	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "missing required flag: --from")
}

func TestListCommand_ShowsUnreadMessages(t *testing.T) {
	db := testutil.NewTestDBWithModels(t)
	defer db.Close()

	// Insert 2 messages for agent "mike"
	msg1 := csuite.CsuiteInboxMessage{FromAgent: "alice", ToAgent: "mike", Subject: "Msg 1", Archived: false}
	msg2 := csuite.CsuiteInboxMessage{FromAgent: "bob", ToAgent: "mike", Subject: "Msg 2", Archived: false}
	msg3 := csuite.CsuiteInboxMessage{FromAgent: "charlie", ToAgent: "mike", Subject: "Archived Msg", Archived: true}
	msg4 := csuite.CsuiteInboxMessage{FromAgent: "dave", ToAgent: "someone-else", Subject: "Other Agent", Archived: false}

	err := db.Create(&msg1).Error
	require.NoError(t, err)
	err = db.Create(&msg2).Error
	require.NoError(t, err)
	err = db.Create(&msg3).Error
	require.NoError(t, err)
	err = db.Create(&msg4).Error
	require.NoError(t, err)

	var stdout bytes.Buffer
	args := []string{"list", "--agent", "mike"}

	err = run(args, db, &stdout)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	output := stdout.String()
	assert.Contains(t, output, "Msg 1")
	assert.Contains(t, output, "Msg 2")
	assert.NotContains(t, output, "Archived Msg")
	assert.NotContains(t, output, "Other Agent")
}

func TestArchiveCommand_ArchivesMessage(t *testing.T) {
	db := testutil.NewTestDBWithModels(t)
	defer db.Close()

	msg := csuite.CsuiteInboxMessage{FromAgent: "alice", ToAgent: "bob", Subject: "Archive Me", Archived: false}
	err := db.Create(&msg).Error
	require.NoError(t, err)

	args := []string{"archive", "--id", msg.ID.String()}
	err = run(args, db, nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	var updatedMsg csuite.CsuiteInboxMessage
	err = db.First(&updatedMsg, msg.ID).Error
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.True(t, updatedMsg.Archived)
}

func TestWatchCommand_ExitsOnContext(t *testing.T) {
	db := testutil.NewTestDBWithModels(t)
	defer db.Close()

	args := []string{"watch"}
	err := run(args, db, nil)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
}
